collected_at_level.x-epack-summary: The collection level the run used.

account_id.x-epack-summary: ID of the Azure subscription the entry describes.

secure_score_pct.x-epack-null: Defender for Cloud reports a maximum score of 0 for the subscription.
secure_score_pct.x-epack-summary: Defender for Cloud's secure score for the subscription, as a percentage of the maximum score.
secure_score_pct.x-epack-method: Reads the percentage from Defender for Cloud's ascScore secure score, or divides its current score by its maximum.

unpatched_pct.x-epack-null: Defender for Cloud has no healthy or unhealthy patch or vulnerability assessment for the subscription.
unpatched_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of Defender for Cloud's system update and vulnerability assessments on the subscription that are unhealthy.
unpatched_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the unhealthy Defender for Cloud assessments whose name, display name or categories mention updates, patches or vulnerabilities by the healthy and unhealthy ones.

defender.x-epack-summary: The subscription's Microsoft Defender for Cloud scores.

owner_count.x-epack-summary: Owner role assignments at the subscription or inherited from above it.
owner_count.x-epack-method: Counts the role assignments at or above the subscription's scope whose role definition is Owner.

owner_service_principal_count.x-epack-summary: Owner role assignments held by service principals.
owner_service_principal_count.x-epack-method: Counts the Owner role assignments whose principal type is ServicePrincipal.

rbac.x-epack-summary: Owner role assignments that apply to the subscription.

assignments_count.x-epack-summary: Azure Policy assignments that apply to the subscription.
assignments_count.x-epack-method: Counts the assignments in Azure Policy's list for the subscription with the atScope() filter. Assignments on resource groups and resources inside the subscription are not counted.

compliant_pct.x-epack-null: No policy is assigned, or the assigned policies have evaluated no resources.
compliant_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of evaluated resources that comply with the assigned policies.
compliant_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the compliant resources in Azure Policy's latest state summary by its compliant and noncompliant resources.

noncompliant_resources_count.x-epack-null: No policy is assigned to the subscription.
noncompliant_resources_count.x-epack-summary: Resources that fail at least one assigned policy.
noncompliant_resources_count.x-epack-method: Reads the noncompliant resource count from Azure Policy's latest state summary.

policy.x-epack-summary: Azure Policy assignments on the subscription and how its resources comply.

storage_accounts_count.x-epack-method: Counts the storage accounts in the subscription.

https_only_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of storage accounts that accept only HTTPS traffic.
https_only_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the storage accounts with supportsHttpsTrafficOnly true by all storage accounts.

min_tls12_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of storage accounts whose minimum TLS version is 1.2 or later.
min_tls12_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the storage accounts whose minimumTlsVersion is TLS1_2 or later by all storage accounts.

encryption_cmk_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of storage accounts encrypted with a customer-managed key in Key Vault. Azure encrypts every storage account at rest, with Microsoft-managed keys by default.
encryption_cmk_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the storage accounts whose encryption key source is Microsoft.Keyvault by all storage accounts.

infrastructure_encryption_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of storage accounts that also encrypt data at the infrastructure layer with a second key.
infrastructure_encryption_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the storage accounts with requireInfrastructureEncryption true by all storage accounts.

public_access_blocked_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of storage accounts that disallow anonymous blob access. The account setting overrides the setting of each container.
public_access_blocked_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the storage accounts with allowBlobPublicAccess false by all storage accounts. An account without allowBlobPublicAccess counts as allowing anonymous access.

network_restricted_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of storage accounts that refuse public network traffic by default. Traffic then comes only from allowed networks and private endpoints.
network_restricted_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the storage accounts with publicNetworkAccess Disabled or networkAcls.defaultAction Deny by all storage accounts.

storage.x-epack-summary: Security settings of the subscription's storage accounts.

vaults_count.x-epack-method: Counts the key vaults in the subscription.

purge_protection_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of key vaults with purge protection on. Purge protection stops a deleted vault or secret from being removed for good until its retention period ends.
purge_protection_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the key vaults with enablePurgeProtection true by all key vaults.

rbac_authorization_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of key vaults that use Azure RBAC for data access. The others use vault access policies.
rbac_authorization_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the key vaults with enableRbacAuthorization true by all key vaults.

keyvault.x-epack-summary: Protection and access settings of the subscription's key vaults.

servers_count.x-epack-summary: Azure SQL logical servers in the subscription.
servers_count.x-epack-method: Counts the Azure SQL servers in the subscription.

databases_count.x-epack-summary: Databases on the subscription's Azure SQL servers, leaving out each server's master database.
databases_count.x-epack-method: Counts the databases on each SQL server, leaving out master.

tde_enabled_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of SQL databases with transparent data encryption on.
tde_enabled_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the databases whose current transparent data encryption state is Enabled by all databases other than master.

min_tls12_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of SQL servers whose minimum TLS version is 1.2 or later.
min_tls12_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the SQL servers whose minimalTlsVersion is 1.2 or later by all SQL servers.

public_access_disabled_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of SQL servers with public network access turned off.
public_access_disabled_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the SQL servers whose publicNetworkAccess is Disabled by all SQL servers.

sql.x-epack-summary: Security settings of the subscription's Azure SQL servers and databases.

virtual_machines_count.x-epack-method: Counts the virtual machines in the subscription.

disk_encryption_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of virtual machines whose OS disk and every data disk are managed disks or use Azure Disk Encryption.
disk_encryption_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the virtual machines whose OS disk and data disks are all managed disks or have encryptionSettings enabled by all virtual machines.

public_ip_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of virtual machines with a network interface that has a public IP address.
public_ip_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the virtual machines with a network interface that a public IP address's IP configuration belongs to by all virtual machines.

compute.x-epack-summary: Disk encryption and public addresses of the subscription's virtual machines.

retention_days_min.x-epack-null: No backup policy that a protected item uses sets a retention period.
retention_days_min.x-epack-summary: The shortest retention period in the backup policies that the protected items of the subscription's Recovery Services vaults use. Months count as 30 days and years as 365.
retention_days_min.x-epack-method: Takes the shortest positive retention duration in the backup policies that the protected items of the subscription's Recovery Services vaults use. A month counts as 30 days and a year as 365.

protected_resource_pct.x-epack-null: The subscription has no virtual machines or SQL databases.
protected_resource_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of virtual machines and SQL databases that a Recovery Services vault backs up.
protected_resource_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the virtual machines and SQL databases that a backup item in a Recovery Services vault protects by all virtual machines and SQL databases other than master.

latest_successful_backup_age_hours_max.x-epack-null: No backup job in the vaults' job history has completed successfully.
latest_successful_backup_age_hours_max.x-epack-summary: Hours since the oldest successful backup job in the vaults' job history ended.
latest_successful_backup_age_hours_max.x-epack-method: Takes the most hours since the end of any completed or succeeded Backup job in the Recovery Services vaults' job history.

failed_jobs_7d_count.x-epack-null: The subscription has no Recovery Services vault.
failed_jobs_7d_count.x-epack-summary: Backup jobs in the last 7 days that failed.
failed_jobs_7d_count.x-epack-method: Counts the Backup jobs in the Recovery Services vaults' job history that failed in the last 7 days.

vault_soft_delete_pct.x-epack-null: The subscription has no Recovery Services vault.
vault_soft_delete_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of Recovery Services vaults with soft delete on. Soft delete keeps deleted backup data for a period before it is removed.
vault_soft_delete_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the Recovery Services vaults whose soft delete state is Enabled or AlwaysON by all vaults.

vault_immutability_pct.x-epack-null: The subscription has no Recovery Services vault.
vault_immutability_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of Recovery Services vaults with immutability on, locked or unlocked. Immutability blocks changes that would delete recovery points early.
vault_immutability_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the Recovery Services vaults whose immutability state is Enabled, Locked or Unlocked by all vaults.

backup.x-epack-summary: Backup coverage, job results and vault protections in the subscription's Recovery Services vaults.

network_security_groups_count.x-epack-summary: Network security groups in the subscription.
network_security_groups_count.x-epack-method: Counts the network security groups in the subscription.

public_ip_addresses_count.x-epack-summary: Public IP addresses in the subscription.
public_ip_addresses_count.x-epack-method: Counts the public IP addresses in the subscription.

ssh_open_to_world_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of network security groups with an inbound rule that allows SSH on port 22 from any address.
ssh_open_to_world_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the network security groups with an inbound Allow rule for TCP port 22 from *, Any, Internet, 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 by all network security groups.

rdp_open_to_world_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of network security groups with an inbound rule that allows RDP on port 3389 from any address.
rdp_open_to_world_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the network security groups with an inbound Allow rule for TCP port 3389 from *, Any, Internet, 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 by all network security groups.

network.x-epack-summary: Network security groups and public IP addresses in the subscription.

subscription_diagnostic_settings_enabled.x-epack-summary: Whether a diagnostic setting sends any Activity Log category of the subscription to a destination.
subscription_diagnostic_settings_enabled.x-epack-method: Checks for a subscription diagnostic setting with a destination and an enabled log or metric category.

activity_log_administrative_exported.x-epack-summary: Whether a diagnostic setting sends the subscription's Administrative Activity Log events to a destination. These events record changes to resources.
activity_log_administrative_exported.x-epack-method: Checks for a subscription diagnostic setting with a destination that enables the Administrative category or the allLogs category group.

diagnostic_settings_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of monitored resources with a diagnostic setting that sends logs or metrics to a destination.
diagnostic_settings_coverage_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the monitored resources with a diagnostic setting that has a destination and an enabled log or metric category by all monitored resources. A storage account's setting can be on the account or on its blob, file, queue or table service. A SQL server's setting is on its master database.

monitored_resources_count.x-epack-summary: Storage accounts, key vaults, SQL servers, SQL databases and virtual machines in the subscription.
monitored_resources_count.x-epack-method: Counts the storage accounts, key vaults, SQL servers, SQL databases other than master and virtual machines in the subscription. A SQL server is counted by its master database.

resources_without_diagnostics_count.x-epack-null: The subscription has no storage account, key vault, SQL server or database, or virtual machine.
resources_without_diagnostics_count.x-epack-summary: Monitored resources with no diagnostic setting that sends logs or metrics to a destination.
resources_without_diagnostics_count.x-epack-method: Counts the monitored resources with no diagnostic setting that has a destination and an enabled log or metric category. A storage account's setting can be on the account or on its blob, file, queue or table service. A SQL server's setting is on its master database.

logging.x-epack-summary: Where the subscription's Activity Log and its resources' logs are sent.

resource_groups_count.x-epack-summary: Resource groups that hold the subscription's resources.

regions_count.x-epack-summary: Azure regions the subscription's resources are in.
regions_count.x-epack-method: Counts the distinct locations of the subscription's resources other than global, which is not a region.

owner_tag_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of resources with an owner tag, such as owner, businessowner or managedby.
owner_tag_coverage_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the resources with a nonempty owner, applicationowner, businessowner, serviceowner, contact or managedby tag by all resources. Tag keys are compared without case, spaces or punctuation.

environment_tag_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of resources with a nonempty environment, env or stage tag.
environment_tag_coverage_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the resources with a nonempty environment, env or stage tag by all resources. Tag keys are compared without case, spaces or punctuation.

production_resources_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of resources whose environment tag is prod or production.
production_resources_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the resources whose first nonempty environment, env or stage tag, in that order, is prod or production by all resources.

type.x-epack-summary: An Azure resource type, such as Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts.

count.x-epack-summary: Resources of this type in the subscription.

top_resource_types.x-epack-summary: The 10 most common resource types in the subscription, with their counts.

inventory.x-epack-summary: The subscription's resources by group, region, type and tag.

accounts.x-epack-summary: One entry for each configured subscription, in the configured order.

tenant_errors.x-epack-summary: Errors from reading tenant-wide Entra data.

subscription_errors.x-epack-summary: Errors from reading a subscription. Each one starts with the subscription ID.

warnings.x-epack-summary: Warnings from the run, such as a metric left out because a permission or license is missing.

truncated.x-epack-summary: Whether the area's list was cut short.
truncated.x-epack-method: Records whether the area's list was cut short.

dropped_count.x-epack-summary: Items left out of the area's list when it was cut short.
dropped_count.x-epack-method: Counts the items left out of the area's list.

additionalProperties.x-epack-summary: Whether one area's list was cut short and how many items were dropped.

truncation.x-epack-summary: Lists cut short during collection, keyed by area.

entra_tier.x-epack-summary: The tenant's Entra ID license tier, or unknown.

capabilities_unavailable.x-epack-summary: Features the run could not read because a license or permission is missing. Values that depend on them are left out.

license.x-epack-summary: The Entra license tier and the features the run could not read.

diagnostics.x-epack-summary: Errors, warnings, truncation and licensing notes from the run. They show which readings may be incomplete.
